ValidationRule.description: Throws error if the Case changes to the Support Coach Queue or Digital Fraud Queue and the Record Type is not Direct Debit or Direct Entry.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ISCHANGED(Queue__c), OR( Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Support Coach Queue', Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Digital Fraud Queue'), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Direct_Debit_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Direct_Entry_Dispute') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For this Dispute Type, please select either Card Disputes - General Queue or Card Disputes - Fraud Queue.
